findings.title: Three of the four named liveness-flake sites are untouched and unquarantined — only test_engine_agy.sh's grown-while case was fixed (agy heartbeat:298, claude:363 and :413, codex:395 and :445 still sample one instant), and `log_grew_while_alive` is local to test_engine_agy.sh instead of a shared helper

The classifier recognises only the two operator hand-offs; harness faults and repository-known-flaky tests are explicitly charged, and tests/test_drive.sh:3348-3351 pins the L020 streaming signature and a reaped-manifest harness fault as `candidate`, the direct opposite of the mandatory clause "the classifier half of this task must recognise this failure signature as a non-candidate failure"

The NAMED CASE from L003 — a fresh worktree missing gitignored build state — is pinned as CHARGED (tests/test_drive.sh:3346, docs/troubleshooting.md "Anything else charges") rather than classified environmental and waived as the acceptance criteria require
Dispatch neither reproduces nor detects absent gitignored build state; PROTOCOL.md only adds prose telling the operator to provision it, so each project still rediscovers the gap by losing a round
